note: Positive allowlist for the source-only release package (G-PKG, D-059), used by tools/r3hd_release_audit.py. Anything not matched by an 'allow' glob is rejected (fail closed). Globs are POSIX, relative to the package root; '*' does not cross '/', '**/' matches zero or more directories. Every kind is a text kind: the audit also requires valid UTF-8 without NUL bytes. deny_paths are root-relative directory prefixes, deny_segments are path segments at any depth (both case-insensitive). The audit is technical only and is NOT a legal clearance. G6-P31 (D-287): accepted_findings records reviewed KEY_MATERIAL / DEVELOPER_PATH / GENERATED_CODE findings exactly (one path, SHA-256 of each accepted line or of the whole file, a class and a reason); scope 'development' entries do not apply to the public audit (--scope public) that tools/r3hd_public_export.py runs.
